q_en:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Critical theory of technology is a political theory of modernity with a normative dimension. It comes from a tradition extending from Marx to Foucault and Habermas which says that advances in the formal claims of human rights take centre stage. Marx attributed this trajectory to the capitalist rationalisation of production. It is prevalent in every modern political system. This trajectory arose from the problems of control over a disempowered and deskilled labour force; but everywhere it is organised — be it Foucault's prisons or Habermas's public sphere — the same pattern prevails. Technological design is shaped by this pattern as the material base of a distinctive social order. In accordance with the notion of thought, critical theory of technology regards technologies as an environment rather than as a collection of tools. We are surrounded by technologies that determine our way of life. The theory builds an approach on the lessons of these histories. In this respect, they are comparable to laws and customs. These institutions said to represent those who live under their sway through privileging certain dimensions of their human nature. Laws of property represent the interest in ownership. Customs like parental authority represent the interest of childhood in safety and growth. Interests, such as these constitute the version of human nature sanctioned by society. The concept of nature suggests an alternative. The reference here is, of course, not to the nature of natural science, but to the lived nature in which we find ourselves and which we are.
Which of the following assertions most appropriately sums up the theme of the passage?
op_en: Certain aspects of human nature, like earning more and more, are given more weight in technological surroundings than in laws and norms.
If viewed as institutions, technology, laws, and customs are similar to each other.
Automobiles are a symbol of the human desire for mobility and spiritual upliftment.
Laws, customs, and technology are similar but different phenomena are applied for them.

भारत का संविधान भारतीय गणराज्य का सर्वोच्च कानून है। यह देश की राजनीतिक व्यवस्था के लिए रूपरेखा तैयार करता है, सरकार की संस्थाओं की शक्तियों एवं उत्तरदायित्वों को परिभाषित करता है। संविधान के द्वारा मौलिक अधिकारों की रक्षा के साथ-साथ शासन के सिद्धांतों को भी रेखांकित किया जाता है। संविधान में देश के प्रशासन का मार्गदर्शन करने वाले नियमों और विनियमों का एक समूह होता है।
